title: CNMD - CellMobileData schema
description: Mobile-device movement metrics reported for a geographic cell and time period.

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be CellMobileData.

endDate.description: Property. End of the reporting period, in ISO 8601 format.

numberOfDistinctDevices.description: Property. Number of distinct devices in the cell during the reporting period.

numberOfDistinctDevicesInRoaming.description: Property. Number of distinct roaming devices in the cell during the reporting period.

numberOfDistinctDevicesByCountry.description: Property. Number of distinct devices grouped by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

numberOfEnteringDevices.description: Property. Number of distinct devices that entered the cell during the reporting period.

numberOfLeavingDevices.description: Property. Number of distinct devices that left the cell during the reporting period.

numberOfEntryDevicesRoaming.description: Property. Number of distinct roaming devices that entered the cell during the reporting period.

numberOfLeavingDevicesRoaming.description: Property. Number of distinct roaming devices that left the cell during the reporting period.

refMobileDeviceCell.description: Relationship. Reference to the MobileDeviceCell to which the metrics apply.

startDate.description: Property. Start of the reporting period, in ISO 8601 format.

top10RegionOriginDevice.description: Property. Between one and ten municipalities of origin for devices entering the cell.
